import pandas as pd, glob, os
ap=pd.read_csv('airports.csv').set_index('airport')
res={}
for f in glob.glob('airlines/*.csv'):
 c=os.path.basename(f)[:2]; d=pd.read_csv(f).drop_duplicates('flight_id').copy()
 isutc='date_utc' in d.columns
 datecol='date_utc' if isutc else 'date'; sched='sched_dep_utc' if isutc else 'sched_dep'; actual='actual_dep_utc' if isutc else 'actual_dep'
 d[datecol]=pd.to_datetime(d[datecol])
 # scheduled timestamp in source time basis; for AS convert to local date for month
 sched_ts=pd.to_datetime(d[datecol].dt.strftime('%Y-%m-%d')+' '+d[sched].fillna('00:00'))
 act_ts=pd.to_datetime(d[datecol].dt.strftime('%Y-%m-%d')+' '+d[actual].fillna('00:00'))
 # clock rollover
 act_ts=act_ts.where(act_ts>=sched_ts, act_ts+pd.Timedelta(days=1))
 if isutc:
  offsets=d.origin.map(ap['utc_offset_hours']).astype(float)
  local_sched=sched_ts+pd.to_timedelta(offsets,unit='h')
 else: local_sched=sched_ts
 feb=local_sched.dt.month.eq(2)&local_sched.dt.year.eq(2025)
 d=d[feb].copy(); delay=(act_ts[feb]-sched_ts[feb]).dt.total_seconds()/60
 completed=~d.cancelled.astype(bool)
 delayed=(delay>15)&completed
 res[c]={'rows':len(d),'completed':int(completed.sum()),'delayed':int(delayed.sum()),'rate':round(100*delayed.sum()/completed.sum(),1)}
 print(c,res[c], 'cancelled',int((~completed).sum()), 'delay range',delay[completed].min(),delay[completed].max())
print(res)

import pandas as pd, glob
ap=pd.read_csv('airports.csv'); print(ap.to_string(index=False))
rows=[]
for f in glob.glob('airlines/*.csv'):
 d=pd.read_csv(f)
 carrier=f.split('/')[-1][:2]
 d=d.drop_duplicates('flight_id', keep='first').copy()
 # create UTC-ish datetime for delay calculation, and local date for month
 if 'date_utc' in d:
  d['sched_dt']=pd.to_datetime(d.date_utc+' '+d.sched_dep_utc, utc=True)
  d['actual_dt']=pd.to_datetime(d.date_utc+' '+d.actual_dep_utc, utc=True)
  # actual may after midnight: add day if clock-based timestamp appears before sched
  mask=d.actual_dep_utc.notna() & (d.actual_dt<d.sched_dt)
  d.loc[mask,'actual_dt'] += pd.Timedelta(days=1)
  offs=ap.set_index('airport').utc_offset_hours
  d['local_date']=(d.sched_dt + d.origin.map(offs).map(lambda x: pd.Timedelta(hours=x))).dt.date
 else:
  d['sched_dt']=pd.to_datetime(d.date+' '+d.sched_dep)
  d['actual_dt']=pd.to_datetime(d.date+' '+d.actual_dep, errors='coerce')
  mask=d.actual_dep.notna() & (d.actual_dt<d.sched_dt)
  d.loc[mask,'actual_dt'] += pd.Timedelta(days=1)
  d['local_date']=pd.to_datetime(d.date).dt.date
 feb=d[pd.to_datetime(d.local_date).dt.month.eq(2)]
 completed=~feb.cancelled
 delays=((feb.actual_dt-feb.sched_dt).dt.total_seconds()/60>15) & completed
 rows.append((carrier,len(feb),completed.sum(),delays.sum(),100*delays.sum()/completed.sum()))
print(pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['carrier','feb','completed','delayed','rate']))

rows=[]
for f in glob.glob('airlines/*.csv'):
 c=os.path.basename(f)[:2]; d=pd.read_csv(f).drop_duplicates('flight_id').copy()
 utc='date_utc' in d.columns
 datecol='date_utc' if utc else 'date'; sched='sched_dep_utc' if utc else 'sched_dep'; actual='actual_dep_utc' if utc else 'actual_dep'
 # construct timestamps; datetime handles dates/times, actual after midnight requires add if raw time less sched
 s=pd.to_datetime(d[datecol]+' '+d[sched])
 a=pd.to_datetime(d[datecol]+' '+d[actual].fillna(d[sched]))
 # if actual clock < scheduled, roll forward day
 a=a.where(a>=s,a+pd.Timedelta(days=1))
 if utc:
  local_date=(s + d.origin.map(ap.utc_offset_hours).map(pd.Timedelta, unit='h')).dt.date
 else: local_date=s.dt.date
 feb=pd.Series(local_date,index=d.index).astype(str).str.startswith('2025-02')
 comp=feb & (~d.cancelled)
 delayed=comp & ((a-s).dt.total_seconds()/60>15)
 rows.append([c, int(feb.sum()),int(comp.sum()),int(delayed.sum()),100*delayed.sum()/comp.sum()])
print(pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['carrier','Feb flights','completed','delayed','rate']))
